- CI run: https://github.com/navapbc/rebar/actions/runs/35488608320
- Verdict: `rebar-ci-bot` cast **`Verified +1` — SUCCESS**, every job green (lint +
  type-check, the `ubuntu-latest, py3.13` gating pytest cell and the rest of the matrix,
  sandbox enforcement, mutation, artifact-probe, authorship, optionality,
  scanner-integration).
- Landed: submitted revision-scoped and merged to `main`.

`AGENTS.md` defines `make test` as selecting exactly what CI's gating `ubuntu-latest, py3.13`
cell selects, and describes a local `make verify` as "the locally checkable **half** of
`Verified`". CI ran that selection plus the rest of the matrix and passed, so this is the
stronger of the two signals.
